append.detail: ── PARKED 2026-09-30. OWNER RULING 2026-09-30 ~01:35Z (multiple choice, recorded by HYG-156, ADR-1672): "Wait for real customers". The five loops are proven by real buyers as they come, not by a scheduled pass of deliberate purchases. REVISIT TRIGGER: the first real sales, for example Returning Home on 2026-10-23; reopen on the first settled row of any of the four unproven loops. The probe is unchanged (five tables non-zero, counting settled rows only) and is not run while parked. The priority stays P0: the cost is unchanged, and the owner has chosen when to pay it. ⚠️ Returning Home cannot sell yet: its host still had no Stripe Connect account at 2026-09-30 01:37Z (OWN-074).
